a6q4 |quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Summon Stone Golem''' is a [[minion]] [[spell]] [[active skill|skill]]. It summons a [[Golem]] that grants [[life regeneration]] and increased [[defence]]s to the player while active. The Stone Golem can use a rolling movement skill and a [[taunt]]ing [[AoE]] ground slam in addition to its melee attacks. It has the largest life pool of all available Golems, but, unlike the others, it does not have any energy shield. ==Skill functions and interactions== The golem can use the following skills: * '''Granite Fist''' - Regular melee attack, 100% physical, supported by melee supports. * '''Rolling Stone''' - Attack skill similar to {{il|Whirling Blades}}, 100% physical, supported by melee supports. * '''Slab Slam''' - AoE melee attack approximately 20 units in radius, 100% physical, taunts enemies, supported by melee/AoE supports. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Life Regen
